stories.title: Judge approves $7.25bn Bayer payout to settle claims that Roundup causes cancer
summary: German company faced 65,000 claims from people who said they developed cancer after using weedkillerA Missouri judge on Friday approved Bayer’s $7.25bn settlement of lawsuits ⁠alleging that its weedkiller ​Roundup causes cancer, potentially resolving litigation that has weighed on the German company for close to a decade.Judge Timothy Boyer of a state court in St Louis ⁠found the settlement “fair, reasonable and adequate”.
